name: Meimou Halloween
source:
It's October 31st, meaning it's Halloween! So I carved a pumpkin and then the damn thing started to talk. And it claims to be the devil, lol. Also, "Trick or Treat!" Time to make him go away with treats.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160310113148/http://ankrache.6.ql.bz/d-halloween/index.html]official summary[/url].]
translation:
今天是10月31日，也就是万圣节啦！所以我雕刻了一个南瓜，然后那该死的东西开始说话了。而且还自称是恶魔，哈哈。还有“不给糖就捣蛋！”是时候让他带着零食离开了。

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160310113148/http://ankrache.6.ql.bz/d-halloween/index.html]官方摘要[/url]。]
